abstract: OBJECTIVE: In this article, we present our initial experience with laparoendoscopic single-site surgery (LESS) for adnexal tumors and report on the safety and feasibility of this technique. STUDY DESIGN: We retrospectively reviewed the medical records of the first 94 consecutive patients who underwent LESS for adnexal tumors at Cheil General Hospital and Women's Healthcare Center, Seoul, Korea between March 2009 and July 2010. Our retrospective chart review was approved by our local Institutional Review Board (IRB). We used a homemade wound retractor and surgical glove as the single-port device. All LESS procedures were performed by a single surgeon. RESULTS: Of 94 patients, 90 (95.7%) successfully underwent LESS for the treatment of an adnexal tumor. The mean age of the patients was 38.51 ± 11.65 years, and the mean body mass index was 21.22 ± 2.79 kg/m(2). The mean operative time was 50.33 ± 13.26 min, and the mean diameter of the adnexal tumors was 6.26 ± 3.19 cm. The procedures included enucleation of an ovarian cyst (n=56), salpingo-oophorectomy (n=32), and salpingectomy (n=4). Two cases with suspicion for malignancy underwent conversion to laparotomy (2.1%), and frozen sections revealed serous ovarian adenocarcinoma (n=1) and chronic inflammation (n=1). Except for those two cases, the pathologic diagnoses were confirmed as mature cystic teratoma (n=30), endometriosis (n=24), mucinous cystadenoma (n=14), serous cystadenoma (n=14), borderline ovarian tumor (n=4), hydrosalpinx (n=4), serous adenocarcinoma of the salpinx (n=1), and ectopic pregnancy (n=1). Two cases required an additional trocar for adhesiolysis of severe pelvic adhesion. No major intraoperative or postoperative complications occurred. CONCLUSIONS: Our results suggest that LESS is a safe and feasible alternative to conventional laparoscopic surgery for the treatment of adnexal tumors.
abstract_ja: 目的: 付属器腫瘍に対する単孔式腹腔鏡手術(LESS)の初期経験を報告し、その安全性と実行可能性を検討する。研究デザイン: 2009年3月から2010年7月までに、韓国ソウルのCheil General Hospital and Women's Healthcare Centerで付属器腫瘍に対しLESSを受けた連続94例の診療録を後方視的に検討した。施設内審査委員会(IRB)の承認を得た。単孔デバイスとして自作の創開創器と手術用手袋を使用した。全LESS手術は1人の術者が施行した。結果: 94例中90例(95.7%)が付属器腫瘍に対するLESSを完遂した。患者の平均年齢は38.51±11.65歳、平均BMIは21.22±2.79kg/m²であった。平均手術時間は50.33±13.26分、付属器腫瘍の平均径は6.26±3.19cmであった。術式は卵巣嚢胞摘出術(56例)、卵管卵巣摘出術(32例)、卵管摘出術(4例)であった。悪性腫瘍が疑われた2例(2.1%)は開腹術に移行し、術中迅速病理で漿液性卵巣腺癌(1例)と慢性炎症(1例)と判明した。その2例を除き、病理診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(30例)、子宮内膜症(24例)、粘液性嚢胞腺腫(14例)、漿液性嚢胞腺腫(14例)、境界悪性卵巣腫瘍(4例)、水腫卵管(4例)、卵管漿液性腺癌(1例)、子宮外妊娠(1例)であった。重度の骨盤癒着のため、2例で癒着剥離用の追加トロッカーを要した。重大な術中・術後合併症は発生しなかった。結論: LESSは付属器腫瘍の治療において、従来の腹腔鏡手術に代わる安全で実行可能な選択肢であることが示唆された。
